newsitem.title: CHINA: Nanjing Panda sets sales target for 2000.
newsitem.headline: Nanjing Panda sets sales target for 2000.

text.p: Chinese television maker Nanjing Panda Electronics Co is aiming for annual sales worth 20 billion yuan ($2.4 billion) by 2000, the Market Daily said on Wednesday.
Panda, which listed in Hong Kong in May, planned to achieve annual production worth 22 billion yuan by the end of the century, the newspaper said. It gave no comparative figures.
The company in August announced first half 1996 net profits of 86.45 million yuan and said pre-tax profits in the first half rose 10.7 percent to 101 million yuan.

Panda was putting great efforts into producing high technology products introducing advanced teconogy, and was investing 3.0 percent of annual sales income for the development of new products, Market Daily said but gave no details.
